messages.author: 3c72b8e0ea52ed9f
messages.subject: Problems with 'stl' function
parts:
Hi,
I've tried to run following code:

MyDF <- data.frame( timestamp = as.Date(rep(0,10), origin = "2015-01-01"), count = numeric(30))

for(i in 1:nrow(MyDF)) {
  row <- MyDF[i,]
  MyDF[[i,1]] <- as.Date(sample(1:100, 1, replace=FALSE), origin="1972-01-01")
  MyDF[[i,2]] <- sample(1:200, 1, replace=FALSE)
}
data_decomp <- stl(ts(MyDF[[2L]], frequency = 4), s.window = "periodic", robust = TRUE)


But get error:

Exception in thread "main" org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'C_stl' not found
at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateSymbol(Context.java:235)
at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:189)
at org.renjin.invoke.codegen.ArgumentIterator.evalNext(ArgumentIterator.java:61)


Is it possible somehow to use "stl" function in Renjin ?

Thank you!

--
All the best,
Sergey

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Problems with 'stl' function
parts:
Hi there,
We hadn't yet included the fortran code that implements the bulk of the stl function (that's the "C_stl" that renjin complains about).

I've imported the fortran code from GNU R and it happily compiles without complaint, but there does not appear to be any test coverage of this function. I've coded up a quick test but it would be great if you could add a few more substantive tests.

This is fixed in version 0.7.1518

Best,
Alex
